application_integration.basis: No detector has been trained or evaluated; background false-positive evidence is absent.

arbitrary_full_image_inspection.basis: The fixed defect-positive dataset does not represent arbitrary operational or healthy-blade imagery.

class_agnostic_localization.basis: 720 positive full images, 1,065 valid curated boxes, source-isolated split; no healthy controls.

healthy_blade_false_positive_evaluation.basis: No curated or raw image has zero annotated defects.

six_class_detection.basis: All six classes occur in every split, but class support is imbalanced and thunderstrike has only 60 boxes overall.
